trainers.instruction: Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

atoms.a: Adding more cells increases the voltage of the circuit.
Increasing the voltage in  a circuit will make a bulb dimmer.
Decreasing the voltage in  a circuit will make a buzzer quieter.

instruction.text: Put the cell that will make the buzzer the loudest into the circuit.
Put the cell that will make the buzzer the loudest into the circuit.
Put the cell that will make the buzzer the quietest into the circuit.

atoms.b: The voltage of a cell is the “push” that makes ((++electricity water)) flow through a circuit.
atoms.sound: The voltage of a cell is the push that makes electricity flow through a circuit.

instruction.text: Decide what effect the following actions will have on a circuit.

atoms.b: adding a cell to the circuit
exchanging the cell for one with a higher voltage
removing a cell from the circuit
exchanging the cell for one with a lower voltage
